scoring.failure_policy: missing, duplicate, invalid, error or skipped => zero positive credit
scoring.ranking: input order; no score sorting or deduplication
scoring.mrr: reciprocal first same-media overlapping rank across all returned moments
scoring.localization: rank-1 only when correct media; target maximizing tIoU, then minimum boundary error
scoring.best_tiou: maximum across all returned same-media moments, failures and misses zero
scoring.negative_denominator: valid responses only; failures separately counted, never empty successes

metadata.timing: sequential queries, model service preloaded; not a cold-start or load test

limitations: Labels are synthetic script/timeline derived and have not been independently human reviewed.
Fused uses active channels including audio; this corpus has no independent sound-channel gold labels.
Negative nonempty rates describe returned candidates, not calibrated refusal quality. RRF scores are not probabilities.
Fake model runs establish process behavior only, not real-model retrieval quality.
